data.creator_notes:
Slightly wip but works great at the moment. May have moderate changes still though since slightly more unbirth was the original intention. Also I want feedback on the bot for what people want more of in the bot before I tweak it.

Basically “your” umbreon decides to eat your giant pet eevee whole and digest them, and pleasure themself with you while doing so (unbirth)



For those wondering why this is even more fatal than my usual bots, others have similar bots covered and I try to keep all my bots unique, so that even if I am also doing some of the characters that for example @PoiYo (https://janitorai.com/profiles/91e182a8-b163-40ca-9b04-272e8df296d6_profile-of-poi-yo) is doing, my variations are unique enough that the bots are different enough both are worth using.
